result.summary: This is a routine garden request: removing rubbish and construction waste, levelling the ground and laying gravel. The landlord was asked on 17 Jan and hasn't replied, so the first 3-day follow-up was missed. I sent the landlord one reminder asking them to approve a contractor visit to quote, or to choose part of the work or decline. I updated the tenant, asked them to resend the photos we can't see, and set a 3-day hold. I'll escalate only if this second deadline also passes with no reply.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 006 is the first missed follow-up. Approval 16 is still pending and nothing has come back from the landlord. Under the rules, I escalate only after no response at two follow-up deadlines, so the proportionate step is to chase once and set a hold. The classifier rated it a routine garden/external job (safety risk 0.23). Nothing suggests an emergency.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Only one follow-up deadline has been missed, and the landlord can answer this themselves.

alternatives_considered.option: Assign a contractor to quote without approval
alternatives_considered.why_not: There is no approval and no pre-approved spend limit on record, and part of the request (levelling and gravel) may be an improvement for the landlord to decide on.
Approval 16 is already pending, and only one can be pending per ticket.
